drhp.business: The Company operates through two synergistic business verticals: Campus Enablement, which provides full-stack services to higher education institutions to help them scale enrolments, streamline operations and improve academic outcomes; and KLI, which partners with leading Indian and global institutions to develop and deliver undergraduate, postgraduate and professional education programs. Within Campus Enablement, the Company runs a student-recruitment outsourcing business and kOS, a SaaS platform for academic and administrative workflows.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's education sector is undergoing rapid digitization, driven by rising demand for employability-linked degrees, UGC online norms, and enterprise L&D.
- Colleges and universities are competing to attract high-quality students while managing compliance and scale.
- There is increasing demand among professionals for career-focused upskilling, hybrid learning, and global mobility.
- The Company is currently hiring for the coming financial year and should witness good growth in this area.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: The Company has invested in a dedicated learning studio in Bengaluru to enhance content production and faculty engagement, and has developed a proprietary technology stack spanning student recruitment, lead attribution, funnel analytics, learner engagement, and mentor management.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- technology: full-stack student-acquisition technology and execution engine spanning agentic AI lead nurturing, automated sales process management, attribution/UTM tracking and real-time analytics dashboards — evidence: leading institutions including JAGSoM, Vijaybhoomi University and IFIM College use this infrastructure, and the Company onboarded over 900 students across all its customers over the last year
- customer lock-in: kOS SaaS platform embeds CRM, admissions, timetabling, attendance, fees, evaluations and regulatory reporting into a partner institution's core administrative workflow — evidence: kOS is described as making DSJKL 'a critical operating partner for educational institutions seeking scale with accountability' [planned]

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Changes in AICTE/UGC/BCI norms for online/hybrid education models could affect the Company's product models; mitigated by a legal team and flexible product models.
- Dependence on individual partner institutions/schools; the Company discloses vertical and geography diversification as its mitigation strategy.
- Risk of student default or institutional payment delays; mitigated through installment-based models and clause-based invoicing.
- Dependence on adjunct faculty and technology to scale delivery; mitigated via the learning studio, playbooks, and central operational QA.
- The Company faces competition from local players in the cities it expands into; addressed by building brand and consumer-centric processes.
- The Company's success depends largely upon the quality and competence of its management team and key personnel.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build out clear growth paths and capability frameworks across key verticals — product and engineering in kOS, content and academic delivery in keeplearning.live, and partner success roles under Campus Enablement.
- Strengthen onboarding and training programs for new hires, especially in the Campus Enablement and kOS teams, to support rapid scaling.
- Roll out quarterly engagement initiatives and manager development programs to support team well-being, leadership depth, and reduce avoidable attrition.
- Consolidate hiring operations to improve turnaround time for business-critical roles and deepen partnerships with hiring platforms and academic institutions.
- Expand the DDGL product beyond Accounting into MSc programs in Marketing, Finance, Luxury Management, and Business Analytics/Data Science, in collaboration with Tier-1 universities across Europe and the US.
- Scale adoption of kOS as a standalone SaaS product to new higher education institutions.
- Maintain focus on improving EBITDA margins, reducing working capital cycles, and sustaining positive cash flow.

hero.oneLiner: DSJ Keep Learning Limited is an education company enabling growth across the higher education value chain through two verticals: Campus Enablement and KLI.
